text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold City has managed to leave quite a
mark on
the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Together, we've successfully navigated
the crucial
first three years of her career.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: 今日も見事な低血圧だな！
今日も見事な低血圧だね！

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: もう少し開始時間、遅くしようか？

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I want to run as much as possible.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
There are higher heights to reach, and
I've got to
show you them all.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look at that, I'm feeling more awake
now.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: 走るのが大好きなんだなって思ってる

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's start with a warm-up. Here
I go.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold City takes off running. Bathed in
the
sunlight, she breaks into a smile.
Today, like so
many days before...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's a beautiful sight to behold.
